definitions.full: H4255. machlqah [ מַחְלְקָה ] noun feminine class, division , of priests and Levites (Biblical Hebrew מַחְםקֶת ); — plural suffix מַחְלְקָֽתְהוֺן Ezra 6:18 . חֲמָר see יחוּ
